# Nectar

> Nectar is an employee recognition and engagement platform that builds workplace culture through peer recognition, rewards, internal communications, and employee listening.

Nectar provides an integrated suite of tools for HR teams and organizations to recognize employees, communicate internally, gather feedback, and measure engagement. The platform supports multi-channel delivery via Slack, Teams, email, and SMS, with features like peer-to-peer recognition, custom challenges, surveys, and eNPS tracking.

## Key Topics

- Employee Recognition
- Peer-to-Peer Recognition
- Employee Engagement
- Internal Communications
- Employee Surveys
- eNPS
- Rewards Program
- Company Culture
- Workplace Culture

## Recognition & Rewards

- [The Employee Recognition Platform to Build Culture - Nectar](https://nectarhr.com/recognition): Nectar recognition platform: peer recognition, rewards, team challenges
- [Boost Employee Engagement through Peer-to-Peer Recognition with Nectar](https://nectarhr.com/recognition-rewards/peer-to-peer-recognition): Peer-to-peer recognition feature with Meaningful Meter™ for engagement
- [Build Culture with Nectar's Employee Rewards Platform](https://nectarhr.com/recognition-rewards/rewards): Nectar rewards platform: gift cards, custom rewards, points redemption
- [Custom Challenges with Nectar - Boost Engagement & Build Team Culture](https://nectarhr.com/recognition-rewards/challenges): Custom challenges feature: gamification, team culture, incentive management
- [Automated Milestone Celebrations and Reward Anniversaries & Birthdays with Nectar](https://nectarhr.com/recognition-rewards/milestones): Automated milestone celebrations: birthdays, anniversaries, recognition
- [Experience Values-Driven Employee Recognition with Nectar](https://nectarhr.com/recognition-rewards/mission-and-values): Values-driven recognition: align wins with company core values
- [Community Recognition - Empower Customers to Celebrate Your Team with Nectar](https://nectarhr.com/recognition-rewards/community-recognition): Community recognition: customer, patient, client appreciation for employees
- [Nectar Employee Nomination Program - Recognize Excellence with Custom Awards](https://nectarhr.com/nomination-program): Peer nomination program with custom awards and recognition analytics

## Internal Communications

- [Internal Employee Announcements & Communications - Nectar](https://nectarhr.com/internal-communications): Internal comms platform: announcements, newsletters via Teams, SMS, email
- [Nectar Internal Comms - Create Stunning Announcements in Minutes](https://nectarhr.com/internal-communications/build): Announcement builder with drag-and-drop editor and AI assistance
- [Easily Share Internal Updates & Bridge the Communication Gap with Nectar](https://nectarhr.com/internal-communications/send): Multi-channel messaging: Slack, email, SMS for employee announcements
- [Organize and Manage Team Communications with Nectar](https://nectarhr.com/internal-communications/manage): Communication campaign management with employee segmentation and HRIS
- [Track and Optimize Internal Communications with Nectar to Boost Engagement](https://nectarhr.com/internal-communications/track): Analytics for internal comms: open rates, click-through rates, insights

## Employee Listening & Surveys

- [Employee Listening](https://nectarhr.com/engage): Employee listening platform: eNPS, surveys, feedback, SafeTalk feature
- [Surveys](https://nectarhr.com/engage/surveys): Custom survey creation with templates and participation incentives
- [eNPS](https://nectarhr.com/engage/enps): eNPS pulse surveys for organizational sentiment and retention tracking
- [Engagement](https://nectarhr.com/engage/engagement): Employee engagement survey tracking progress and trends over time
- [Survey Analytics](https://nectarhr.com/engage/analytics): Survey analytics with heat maps, charts, real-time insights
